title: Chapter 63 Killing The Alligator Lizard
content:
Chapter 63 Killing The Alligator Lizard

Compared with the previous elite crocodiles, the bronze boss crocodile lizard is smaller in size, but its attributes are much higher.

Wang Shuo turned his head to look at Ayub, and then looked at Gong Zheng.

At present, these two people are the combat forces that Wang Shuo relies on the most.

One is good at defense, and the other is good at attack.

After having the flame gun, Wang Shuo's attack power has reached a terrifying 145 points.

Compared with before, it has increased several times, even higher than Ayub.

Gong Kai shot an arrow at the crocodile lizard by the pool.

The injured crocodile lizard rushed over immediately. Wang Shuo originally intended to attract only one, but he didn't expect that he would attract more than ten nearby lizards and rush over together.

However, Wang Shuo and others were not nervous. The ordinary crocodile lizards have low attack and blood volume.

It is not a big problem to deal with them.

In the blink of an eye, the cavalry squads dismounted and fought with these lizards.

The three brothers Li Jianguo were at the lowest level at the moment. Wang Shuo ordered Gong Zheng and Guliji to protect them and assist in the battle.

The golden armored warrior and Ayub were at the front and were responsible for the main output.

He hid behind and was responsible for finishing off the enemy.

Although Wang Shuo had arranged the script, Gong Zheng was under a lot of pressure!

"Gong Zheng, take them and retreat a distance." Wang Shuo looked at Gong Zheng, who was a little overwhelmed, and shouted worriedly.

Even for ordinary crocodile-lipped lizards, Li Jianguo and his three brothers could only cause a few points of damage each time, which was almost negligible for crocodile-lipped lizards with more than 2,000 health points.

With the blessing of the cavalry squad medal, the first wave of crocodile-lipped lizards were quickly killed.

The three brothers with the lowest level were directly upgraded to the next level.

At this time, Wang Shuo also noticed a very important phenomenon.

The dead bodies of the killed animals were no longer decomposed into meat and bones by the system.

Instead, it was a complete body, but the energy crystal would fall next to the body.

Last night, he found that the black bear's body had not been decomposed, and he didn't pay much attention to it at the time.

Now it seems that this should also be a change in the rules.

Ignoring this change, Wang Shuo looked at the other lizards.

Soon another wave came over, and ten minutes later, this wave of monsters was eliminated again.

And this time, a bow and arrow of ordinary quality was dropped.

Everyone in the cavalry squad has been popularized with sophisticated equipment.

Wang Shuo has long looked down on this kind of garbage.

Now only the boss and the eight brothers around it are left.

Wang Shuo asked the three brothers Jianguo to step aside to avoid injury.

He asked Gong to shoot another arrow, and the last wave of crocodile-lipped lizards also crossed the pool and rushed over.

Gong Zheng immediately took over and grabbed the bronze boss, while the golden armored warriors assisted and entangled with the crocodile-lipped lizard named Laxi.

Wang Shuo and Ayub quickly cleaned up the other monsters around.

While Wang Shuo was fighting the alligator lizard, countless battles were also taking place in other places.

On a huge body of water, Liu Dahai was standing on the bow with high spirits. At this moment, he had chosen the main profession of pirate, and a group of players gathered around him, and began to clear monsters in this area.

…

In Tianze Village, Zhao Tianze led his men to capture players. His village now has more than 200 people, becoming the most powerful village around.

…

Chef Zhang brought several players he had gathered, gave up his status as a lord, came to the nearest Nanshan Market, and opened a restaurant. He planned to wait until the battle for the village building order was over, and then become a resident of Nanshan Market and a system town.

…

At the same time, many players began to form their own forces.

In Nanshan Market, there was a player named Zhuge Kewei. Considering that the risk of building a village in the wild was too high, he also took the initiative to give up the idea of building a village.

He chose the swordsman as his main occupation. He quickly raised his level to 18 by killing monsters, and then gathered a group of subordinates, intending to establish a guild in Nanshanji. He had already inquired clearly that as long as he obtained the guild order, he could establish a guild recognized by the system.

The guild order may be dropped by the bronze boss, so he is now leading his subordinates to look for the bronze boss everywhere.

…

By the pond.

After 10 minutes of fighting, Wang Shuo finally killed all the monsters, and Gong Zheng also lost a lot of health at this moment.

Although he has a high-level shield and blocking skills, his level is too different from that of the crocodile lizard. He can barely block its large amount of damage, and he has tried his best.

"Hold on a little longer, we will come to help you." Wang Shuo was a little worried.

His cavalry team must not be reduced in number.

The most powerful attack method of the alligator lizard is to attack with its tough tongue. The slender tongue is like a long whip that can be soft or hard. It can be used to stab or sweep.

And each attack also has a paralysis effect, which makes Gong Zheng miserable. At this moment, Wang Shuo also experienced this terrible attack.

It's like a person's legs feel numb after squatting for a long time.

In addition, you have to be careful of its tail. If you don't dodge in time, you will be slapped away.

Wang Shuo endured the numbness and his hand holding the gun was a little unstable.

At this time, it has entered a critical moment. The life value of the crocodile-mouthed lizard has been nearly half consumed.

Wang Shuo seized the opportunity and stabbed directly into its mouth. If he could attack its tongue, it would not only cause a lot of damage, but also reduce its attack power.

Once again, the flame gun was deflected by the tongue of the crocodile-mouthed lizard.

Wang Shuo frowned and ordered the golden armored warrior to jump on its back and attack.

With a leap, the golden armored warrior landed on the back of the crocodile-mouthed lizard, but there was too much mucus on its back, which was a bit smooth, and the golden armored warrior almost stood unsteadily.

Adjusting his pace, the golden armored warrior quickly stabilized his body, holding the long knife with both hands, and stabbed down fiercely.

Unfortunately, this attack was blocked by the smooth back, leaving only a shallow wound.

The crocodile-mouthed lizard felt pain, opened its mouth and roared repeatedly.

"Roar."

Wang Shuo seized the opportunity and directly performed the "Dragon Transformation Attack".

It hit the crocodile-mouthed lizard directly in the mouth.

Suddenly, a dragon-shaped light came out along the flaming spear.

It was really "a little cold light came first, and then the spear came out like a dragon".

[You used the skill of dragon transformation to attack, causing 560 damage to the crocodile lizard. ]

Seeing the effect of this attack, Wang Shuo was quite satisfied!

Since Wang Shuo's current mental power was only a little over 200, he didn't dare to use this skill at will. Only at this critical moment could it have the best effect.

Then, the attack of the golden armor warrior and Ayub took away nearly 400 health points of the crocodile lizard. As for Guliji and Baililiang, their attack power was too low and they could barely break the defense, and there was not much output.

Wang Shuo used another move, the attack skill "flaming breath" that came with the flaming spear.

It caused 300 damage to the crocodile lizard.

As a result, the crocodile lizard suffered heavy damage and its death was in countdown.

After another round of attacks, the crocodile lizard could no longer move.

Wang Shuo was cautious and guarded against the crocodile lizard's dying counterattack.
